description:
Performs a live HTTP GET scan on a target website URL to inspect 'Set-Cookie' response headers and third-party tracking scripts in the HTML (such as Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, TikTok, Hotjar, Clarity, LinkedIn, Stripe, HubSpot, Intercom, Cloudflare), returning a categorized inventory grouped into Necessary, Analytics, Marketing, and Preferences.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'scan_cookies' when you specifically want the categorized cookie and tracker inventory to populate a Cookie Policy or inspect third-party scripts. Call 'audit_site' instead when you also want security header checks, legal link verification, accessibility, AI Act checks, and an overall compliance score.

Preconditions & side effects: Requires a reachable public HTTP(S) URL; no registry siteId or authentication needed. Read-only live HTTP inspection.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success', 'reachable', 'url', 'total_cookies', 'scripts_detected', 'categorized_inventory' (grouped arrays), 'all_cookies', 'cookie_inventory', 'message', and optional 'error'.
